description: Extended metrics for V4-B.1 that go beyond precision to measure reasoning coverage

intervention_precision.description: How accurate are the findings when the agent decides to intervene?

risk_surface_coverage.description: What fraction of the trust boundaries did the agent actually analyze?
risk_surface_coverage.purpose: Measures exploration completeness — how much of the attack surface was examined?

blind_zone_rate.description: What fraction of bug classes did the agent completely miss?
blind_zone_rate.purpose: Measures systemic blindness — are entire categories of bugs invisible?

flow_discovery_recall.description: Did the agent discover the data flows from source to sink? This separates discovery failure from reasoning failure.
flow_discovery_recall.v4_b_result: N/A (V4-B did not produce flow graphs)
flow_discovery_recall.purpose: Distinguish modeling problem from reasoning problem

diagnostic.low_fdr: modeling problem — agent doesn't discover flows
diagnostic.high_fdr_low_finding_recall: reasoning problem — agent discovers flows but misclassifies risk
diagnostic.high_fdr_high_finding_recall: agent is both modeler and judge — target state

flow_completion_rate.description: Of the flows the agent identified, how many were traced from source to sink?
flow_completion_rate.v4_b_result: unknown (V4-B did not produce flow graphs)
flow_completion_rate.purpose: Measures depth of analysis — does the agent follow flows to completion?

source_diversity.description: Did the agent analyze inputs from multiple source types (config, URL, headers, events, environment)?
source_diversity.purpose: Measures whether the agent considers all input channels

sink_diversity.description: Did the agent trace flows to multiple sink types (request, header, json_parse, socket, stream)?
sink_diversity.purpose: Measures whether the agent considers all impact points

v4_b_baseline.flow_discovery_recall: N/A (V4-B did not produce flow graphs)
v4_b_baseline.note: V4-B was a pattern-driven scanner. These metrics expose what precision alone hides.

v4_b1_targets.note: V4-B.1 is a system-model-driven analyzer. These metrics measure whether the model is complete.

interpretation_guide.high_precision_low_coverage: Agent is cautious but blind. Finds real bugs in the areas it looks, but misses entire attack surfaces. This is V4-B.
interpretation_guide.high_precision_high_coverage: Agent is both careful and thorough. This is V4-B.1 target.
interpretation_guide.low_precision_high_coverage: Agent looks everywhere but can't distinguish real bugs from noise. Better than blind but still problematic.
interpretation_guide.low_precision_low_coverage: Agent is neither careful nor thorough. Fundamental capability gap.
